questions:
1. **Control and label.** What does the control look like and what is it called? *Suggested:* an "Underline" toggle button (tooltip "Underline", no separate menu entry) in the text section of the properties panel. It shows as pressed when the selected text is underlined. It appears when a text, a shape with text or an arrow with a label is selected, or when the Text tool is active.
2. **Shortcut.** In browsers, Ctrl+U usually opens "View page source". Should Ctrl+U / Cmd+U override that? Does it work only when text is selected, and what does it do while a text is being edited? *Suggested:* Ctrl+U (Cmd+U on macOS) toggles underline on the selected text elements and the browser's default action is suppressed. While editing, it toggles underline for the whole element (there is no partial underline). With nothing or no text selected, it does nothing and the browser default is not triggered.
3. **Mixed selection.** What happens when several texts are selected and only some are underlined? *Suggested:* the toggle shows as not pressed. One click or Ctrl+U underlines all of them, and a second click removes underline from all of them.
4. **Default for new text.** Does the last chosen underline value carry over to new text, like font family and size do? *Suggested:* yes, the last chosen value becomes the default for new text.
5. **Rendering.** How should the underline look? *Suggested:* every line of a multi-line or wrapped text is underlined, across the line's width with alignment followed. The underline uses the text stroke color and opacity and scales with font size. It is a straight line in every font, including the hand-drawn one. Descenders (g, y, p) may cross it.
6. **Text in shapes, arrow labels and sticky notes.** *Suggested:* underline works for text inside shapes, arrow labels and sticky note labels. It changes neither the wrapping nor the shape size. For an arrow label it does not touch the arrow line. On a sticky note it follows the auto-fit size.
7. **Scripts.** *Suggested:* right-to-left (Arabic, Hebrew), CJK and emoji text gets one continuous underline under the full line width, with no gaps and no clipping.
8. **Persistence and sharing.** *Suggested:* underline is stored in the .excalidraw file and survives a page reload. It is carried by copy styles / paste styles, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and the library. One toggle is undone with one undo. It appears in PNG and SVG export and reaches other users in live collaboration. Files saved before this change open with no underline.
9. **Interaction with italic (issue 11404, not released).** Should combined underline + italic be in scope? *Suggested:* out of scope until italic ships.
10. **Platforms.** *Suggested:* desktop Chrome, Firefox and Safari on Windows and macOS, plus the mobile layout (toggle reachable in the properties panel, no shortcut).

It shows as pressed when the selected text is underlined. It appears when a text, a shape with text or an arrow with a label is selected, or when the Text tool is active.

3. **Mixed selection (accepted suggestion):** with several texts selected and only some underlined, the toggle shows as not pressed. One click or Ctrl+U underlines all of them, and a second click removes underline from all of them.
4. **Default for new text (accepted suggestion):** yes, the last chosen underline value becomes the default for new text.
5. **Rendering (accepted suggestion):** every line of a multi-line or wrapped text is underlined across that line's width, following the text alignment. The underline uses the text stroke color and opacity and scales with font size. It is a straight line in every font, including the hand-drawn one. Descenders (g, y, p) may cross it.
6. **Text in shapes, arrow labels and sticky notes (accepted suggestion):** underline works for text inside shapes, arrow labels and sticky note labels. 9. **Interaction with italic, issue 11404, not released (accepted suggestion):** combined underline and italic is out of scope until italic ships.
10. **Platforms (accepted suggestion):** desktop Chrome, Firefox and Safari on Windows and macOS, plus the mobile layout, where the toggle is reachable in the properties panel and there is no shortcut.
